name: COREPReturn
description: Represents a single quarterly COREP capital adequacy return at any stage of its lifecycle — from initial draft through validation, sign-off, submission, and post-submission monitoring. This is the primary entity owned by the Regulatory Reporting function within Compliance & Regulatory (CAP-005).

fields.name: return_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the COREP return

fields.name: reporting_period
fields.description: The quarter this return covers

fields.name: return_type
fields.description: Whether this is a solo or consolidated return

fields.name: xbrl_taxonomy_version
fields.description: Version of the PRA COREP XBRL taxonomy used
fields.validation: Required. Must match PRA-published taxonomy version.

fields.name: capital_data_package_id
fields.description: Reference to the CapitalDataPackage consumed from CAP-004

fields.name: templates
fields.description: List of COREP template sections and their population status

items.template_code: string (e.g., CA1, CA2, CR_SA, CR_IRB, MKR_SA, OR)

fields.name: own_funds_cet1
fields.description: Common Equity Tier 1 capital
fields.source: Derived from GL data and prudential adjustments

fields.name: own_funds_at1
fields.description: Additional Tier 1 capital

fields.name: own_funds_t2
fields.description: Tier 2 capital

fields.name: total_own_funds
fields.description: Total own funds = CET1 + AT1 + T2

fields.name: total_rwa
fields.description: Total risk-weighted assets from the capital data package

fields.name: cet1_ratio
fields.description: CET1 ratio = CET1 / total RWA

fields.name: leverage_ratio
fields.description: Leverage ratio = Tier 1 / total exposure measure

fields.name: status
fields.description: Lifecycle status of the COREP return
fields.validation: Required. State transitions enforced by SVC-015.

fields.name: submission_deadline
fields.description: The PRA submission deadline for this return (T+30 or T+42)
fields.validation: Required. Calculated from quarter_end_date and return_type.

fields.name: pra_submission_reference
fields.description: PRA RegData submission reference number
fields.validation: Required when status is SUBMITTED or later.

fields.name: pra_acknowledgement_timestamp
fields.description: When the PRA acknowledged receipt

fields.name: cfo_signoff
fields.description: CFO sign-off record

fields.name: signoff_id
fields.description: Unique ID for the sign-off event

fields.name: signer_identity
fields.description: SM&CR identifier of the CFO

fields.name: attestation_statement
fields.description: The attestation text signed by the CFO

fields.name: signed_at
fields.description: Timestamp of sign-off

fields.name: worm_reference
fields.description: Reference to WORM store record in SVC-111

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Timestamp when the return was created

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: Timestamp of last update

relationships.description: The COREPReturn consumes data from the CapitalDataPackage produced by Risk Management
A COREPReturn may have one or more ValidationResult records
A COREPReturn may have zero or more Restatement records

design_decisions.decision: COREPReturn is owned by SVC-015 (Compliance Core Service) in CAP-005
design_decisions.rationale: The regulatory return is a compliance artefact. The Compliance Core Service is responsible for consolidation, formatting, validation, and submission. The capital calculation data is consumed from CAP-004 via domain events.

design_decisions.decision: CFO sign-off is an embedded object within COREPReturn, not a separate entity
design_decisions.rationale: The sign-off is a single event per return lifecycle (or per restatement). It does not have independent lifecycle or relationships that warrant a separate entity. The WORM reference ensures the attestation is independently auditable.
